groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Before the first truck arrives, I need everyone to check the updated loading plan on the board. Dock 2 will remain closed until the damaged overhead light is replaced, so refrigerated deliveries have been reassigned to Dock 4. Keep the center aisle clear for the electric pallet truck, and report any loose shrink wrap immediately because it can catch in the wheels. The maintenance team expects to reopen Dock 2 after lunch. Until then, supervisors will direct incoming drivers as they enter the yard.

questions.question_text: Why is Dock 2 closed?

options.text: The dock floor is being painted.
A delivery truck is being unloaded there.

questions.question_text: Where will refrigerated deliveries go?
What will supervisors do until Dock 2 reopens?

options.text: Replace shrink wrap on all boxes.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Hi, Jordan. This is Amara from BrightPath Foods. I reviewed the campaign proposal you sent yesterday. The overall direction works for us, especially the customer-story section, but our launch date has moved forward by one week. Could you revise the production schedule and send a new timeline by Wednesday morning? We can keep the same budget if the outdoor photo shoot is replaced with the studio option you mentioned. I will be in meetings after two today, so email is the best way to reach me with any questions.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the voicemail?

options.text: To invite Jordan to a customer event.
To request changes to a campaign schedule.

questions.question_text: How can the current budget be maintained?

options.text: Delay the launch by another week.
Use a studio photo shoot instead of an outdoor one.

questions.question_text: Why does Amara recommend email after two?

options.text: She will be traveling by train.
She will be working in the studio.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Here is the weekly sales summary for our three downtown cafes. Total revenue rose six percent, mostly because breakfast orders increased at the Market Street location after it began opening thirty minutes earlier. Lunch sales at River Plaza were unchanged, while the Station branch sold fewer sandwiches than last week. We also saw a company-wide increase in mobile orders. Next week, we will test a separate pickup shelf at Station to see whether faster collection improves lunchtime traffic there.

questions.question_text: What contributed most to the revenue increase?

options.text: A new lunch menu at River Plaza.
Lower delivery fees at all locations.
More breakfast orders at Market Street.

questions.question_text: What trend occurred at all three cafes?
What will be tested at the Station branch?

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: May I have your attention, conference guests. The eleven o'clock session on regional supply chains has been moved from Room 204 to the Lakeside Hall because registrations exceeded the room's capacity. The session will still begin at eleven and will use the same speaker lineup. Attendees who requested printed handouts can collect them at a table outside Lakeside Hall. The networking workshop originally scheduled there at twelve thirty will instead meet in Room 204, so please check the updated signs before the next session block.

questions.question_text: Why was the supply-chain session moved?

options.text: Too many people registered for Room 204.
A speaker requested a larger stage.

questions.question_text: What remains unchanged for the eleven o'clock session?

options.text: Its registration limit and seating plan.

questions.question_text: Where will the networking workshop take place?

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Starting today, the handheld scanners will ask for one extra confirmation when you count high-value electronics. After scanning the shelf label and item barcode, compare the quantity on screen with the physical count. If they match, tap Confirm. If they do not, select Recount before entering a new number. Do not use the Manual Override button unless a supervisor is present, because that action bypasses the second check and creates an audit note. At the end of your aisle, return the scanner to its charging dock even if the battery indicator still looks full.

questions.question_text: What should employees do when the displayed quantity is wrong?

options.text: Scan only the shelf label again.
Place the scanner in its charging dock.
Select Recount before entering a new number.

questions.question_text: Why should Manual Override usually be avoided?

options.text: It permanently deletes the inventory record.
It bypasses a second check and creates an audit note.
It prevents the scanner from charging.
It sends the count directly to a supplier.

questions.question_text: What are employees instructed to do after finishing an aisle?

options.text: Give the scanner to a supervisor.
Turn off the store's wireless network.
Return the scanner to its charging dock.
Print a paper copy of the inventory.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Welcome to the Westbrook Botanical Garden. Our greenhouse tour begins in fifteen minutes at the stone fountain. Because today's temperature is unusually high, the guide has shortened the outdoor portion and added more time inside the climate-controlled orchid house. Visitors with the two o'clock reservation may join the one-thirty tour instead if space is available. The cafe is offering free water refills, and shaded seating has been added beside the rose garden. Please keep your admission wristband visible when moving between areas.

questions.question_text: Why was the tour route adjusted?

options.text: The rose garden has a private event.

questions.question_text: What option is given to visitors with two o'clock reservations?

options.text: Receive a refund at the cafe.
Move their reservation to tomorrow only.
Join the one-thirty tour if there is space.

questions.question_text: What does the speaker ask visitors to keep visible?

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: The renovation of the Eastbrook branch remains on schedule overall. Demolition finished two days early, which gave the electrical crew additional time to install new wiring. However, the custom glass for the front entrance will arrive four days later than planned because the supplier had a production delay. To avoid affecting the reopening date, the team will complete interior painting and shelving before installing the glass. The final safety inspection is still booked for the twenty-eighth, and we have not changed the public reopening announcement.

questions.question_text: What work was completed ahead of schedule?
Why will the entrance glass arrive late?

options.text: The supplier had a production delay.
Measurements had to be taken again.
The project manager changed the design.

questions.question_text: What does the speaker imply about the reopening date?

options.text: It will be announced after the inspection.
It is expected to remain the same.
It has been moved four days later.
It depends on demolition being repeated.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: This afternoon's evacuation drill will begin shortly after three. When the alarm sounds, employees on floors five through eight should use the north stairwell, while floors two through four should use the south stairwell. The main lobby doors will remain locked during the drill so the security team can test the side exits. Once outside, report to your department's sign holder in the west parking area. Do not return to the building when the alarm stops. Wait until the safety coordinator gives the all-clear over the portable speaker.

questions.question_text: Why will the main lobby doors stay locked?

options.text: So visitors cannot enter before three.
Because the lobby is under construction.
So the security team can test side exits.
Because employees must use an elevator.

questions.question_text: Where should employees report after leaving the building?
When may employees return inside?

options.text: As soon as the alarm becomes silent.
When their department sign is removed.
After the safety coordinator gives the all-clear.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Hello, Ms. Nguyen. This is Carlos from Redwood Analytics. We are looking forward to speaking with you about the data coordinator position on Friday. One member of the interview panel will be joining remotely from another time zone, so we would like to move the interview from eleven to eleven forty-five. The office location is unchanged, and your visitor parking code will still work. Please reply to the calendar invitation by tomorrow afternoon. If the new time creates a conflict, add a note to your reply and I will call you to discuss alternatives.

questions.question_text: Why is the interview time being changed?

options.text: A panel member is joining from another time zone.

questions.question_text: What does the speaker say remains valid?
What should Ms. Nguyen do if the new time is a problem?

options.text: Add a note when replying to the invitation.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Before we finish today's onboarding session, there is one security rule I want to emphasize. When you receive a request to change a vendor's bank details, do not update the record from the email alone, even if the message appears to come from a familiar contact. First, call the vendor using the phone number already stored in our accounting system. If the request is legitimate, document the verification in the payment record before making the change. Requests received after three o'clock should be verified the next business morning rather than rushed through at the end of the day.

questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of the instruction?

options.text: To introduce a new accounting vendor.
To explain how to verify bank-detail changes.
To announce a change in business hours.
To teach employees how to file expenses.

questions.question_text: Which phone number should employees use for verification?

options.text: The number already stored in the accounting system.
The number included in the request email.
A number found on the vendor's website.
The personal number of the sender.

questions.question_text: What should happen to requests received after three o'clock?

options.text: They should be forwarded to all managers.
They should be deleted from the system.
They should be verified the next business morning.
